title: East Security says personal data may have leaked from Douzone Bizon's backup service, Boannews reports
date_note: Boannews' 25 November report is the first source; the page gives no earlier day for East Security's disclosure.
summary: Boannews reports that East Security is among the organisations affected by the Douzone Bizon data backup service (APO) incident. The affected data is names and contact details of some customer and partner contacts and former employees, and, depending on the person, resident registration or account numbers may be included. Boannews says the actual leak is not confirmed and East Security is investigating with Douzone Bizon.
plain: A Korean security company says some contacts' and former employees' personal data held in Douzone Bizon's backup service may have leaked. The leak itself is not confirmed and an investigation is under way.
exec: Boannews reports that East Security is investigating with Douzone Bizon a possible leak of contact and former-employee data from Douzone's backup service; the leak is not confirmed.
action: No action needed; for awareness. The page read gives no advice from East Security.

validation.note: Only Boannews was read for East Security's disclosure; no East Security or Douzone page was read.

review.note: Compared title, date, data types and not-confirmed wording against Boannews 25 Nov; single-source label correct
